entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Sri A.K. Singh, Advocate, for revisionist and learned A.G.A. for State are present.

2.  This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 29.08.1995 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etah in Criminal Case No. 1546 of 1990 convicting the revisionist under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing him to undergo six months' rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.
2000/-.
Thereagainst accused-revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 59 of 1995 which has been dismissed by Special Judge (Dacoity Affected Area) vide judgment and order dated 24.09.1997.
This revision has been filed challenging both the aforesaid orders.

3. Learned counsel for revisionist confined his argument by only stating that considering advanced age of revisionist and taking lenient view, punishment of imprisonment may be reduced to the period already undergone.

sentences.text: However, I find no force in any of the above submission.
5. The revisionist has not shown that punishment, awarded by Court below, is unjust, arbitrary or otherwise illegal.

On the contrary, I find that minimum punishment prescribed under Statute has been awarded, and hence the same cannot be reduced as held by Apex Court recent in State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Vikram Das (2019) 4 SCC 125 observing as under:
??

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Vikram Das (2019) 4 SCC 125
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: where minimum sentence is provided for, the Court cannot impose less than the minimum sentence.?
6. In view of above, I do not find any reason to interfere on this score.
7. No other point has been argued.
8. The revision lacks merits.
Dismissed.
5. The revisionist Ram Chandra is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etah shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be reported within two months.
6. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.
Order Date :- 11.9.2019 PS  Ram Chandra vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2019
